# Quest HQ repository instructions

Read [.ai/README.md](../.ai/README.md) before planning, suggesting or making code/data changes, or using database and deployment tools. The .ai folder is the canonical project brain for architecture, product state, operations, and the database map.

Keep it synchronized with material changes; a task is not complete until the relevant files are current. Never add secrets, personal data, or production row payloads.
